cards.back: Geostationary orbit: 35,786 km above the equator, 24-hour period, satellite appears stationary — used for comms and weather

cards.front: Recall a key point about Satellites & Space Probes
cards.back: Low Earth orbit (LEO): 160–2,000 km, ~90-minute period — used for Earth observation and the ISS

cards.front: Recall a key point about Satellites & Space Probes
cards.back: Polar orbit: passes over the poles, allowing full Earth coverage — used for mapping and reconnaissance

cards.back: 1. For Satellites & Space Probes questions, define key terms before explaining processes 2. Use 'because' to link cause and effect in your explanations 3.
